taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-03 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 193.6 | 0.90 | 0.90
2 | 129.1 | 3.18 | 4.08
3 | 29.1 | 0.79 | 4.87
4 | 29.8 | 26.64 | 31.51
5 | 165.4 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as QHA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-03
Curve type: QHA
Aquifer depth: 4.08–31.51 m
Recommendation: Target the low-resistivity zone (layers 3–4, ~29 ohm-m) between 4.08 m and 31.51 m depth for screen placement, as it likely represents the saturated/water-bearing horizon; case off the overlying higher-resistivity layers (0–4.08 m) to prevent inflow of perched or lower-quality water, and confirm the base of the aquifer near 31.5 m before penetrating into the underlying resistive layer 5.
